claims.claim: LoRA freezes pretrained weights and parameterizes low-rank updates using two trainable matrices.
claims.verification_note: ΔW is adapted, not original W reconstructed.

claims.claim: LoRA common scale is alpha divided by rank and init can make the initial adapter update zero.
claims.verification_note: Shapes and sign conventions depend on linear layer orientation.

claims.claim: AdaLoRA uses importance-aware budget allocation of SVD-inspired triplets without repeated exact SVD of full weight matrices.
claims.verification_note: Dynamic rank allocation must include scheduling and scoring.

claims.claim: BitFit fine-tunes bias terms and reports competitive small-to-medium-data outcomes.
claims.verification_note: Performance is task/data specific; does not imply success on bias-free models.

claims.claim: LoRA update can merge into a standard linear weight for inference when arithmetic permits.
claims.verification_note: Quantized/fused versions require explicit parity checks.

claims.claim: AdaLoRA reference PEFT settings expose target rank and allocation schedule.
claims.verification_note: Library implementation is versioned, separate from paper.
